register: du (informal singular, as Danish health apps, sundhed.dk and MinSundhed use). Straight register: calm, plain patient-leaflet Danish using sundhed.dk patient terms; short sentences. Wry register: dry, understated, warm Danish humour; never loud, never crude. No exclamation marks. Danish quotation marks »…«. Times written the Danish way (kl. 3, kl. 21–7).
gender: Gender-neutral throughout: Danish does not mark the user's gender with du. Clinician = 'læge' (gender-neutral).

glossary.surge: bølge (en bølge, bølgen, bølger): '3 bølger', 'Der kommer en bølge', 'Jeg har en bølge'
glossary.night sweat: nattesved (symptom name, mass noun); counted: natlig svedetur / natlige svedeture
glossary.check-in: tjek (et tjek, pl. tjek); evening check-in = aftentjek; verb: tjek ind
glossary.Night Watch: Nattevagt (feature name, capitalised; Siri: 'Slå Nattevagt til i ${applicationName}')
glossary.calm stretch: rolig periode (most days in a row without a bølge)
glossary.Apple Health: appen Sundhed (Apple's Danish name 'Sundhed'); standalone label: Apple Sundhed
glossary.bleeding after menopause: blødning efter menopausen (after periods have stopped; not overgangsalderen)
glossary.menopause: menopause (the point, the last period) / overgangsalderen (the phase, casual copy)
glossary.emergency: alarmcentralen / dit lokale alarmnummer — app inserts number
